predictions.prediction_text: Market will remain unconcerned about a near-term downturn from stagflation as long as earnings resilience supports highs.
predictions.expected_result: Major equity indices will not decline more than 3% in the near term while earnings remain strong

predictions.prediction_text: Thursday and Friday profit-taking may show up on the tape.
predictions.expected_result: Equity prices will experience measurable intraday sell-offs on Thursday or Friday (e.g., daily decline >0.5%)

predictions.prediction_text: Slowing growth will cause a timely repricing that hurts valuation rather than an instant market shift.
predictions.expected_result: Valuation multiples (e.g., P/E) will decline over subsequent weeks, reducing index-level valuations by a noticeable margin (e.g., 5-10%)

predictions.prediction_text: Tail hedge demand will continue to climb as tariff risk materializes.
predictions.expected_result: Demand for tail-hedge instruments (e.g., deep OTM put option open interest or put-call skew) will increase significantly

predictions.prediction_text: The main market regime will be low-volatility oscillation that burns options premium for both bulls and bears.
predictions.expected_result: Realized volatility will remain low and rangebound, producing theta decay dominance and resulting in net option premium erosion for short-dated options (0DTE/1DTE) over the near term
